text:
anya: Pushed round-3 of the Usage & Billing layout. Major changes: single-chart small-multiples for top 5 projects, a summary KPI strip (Total spend, Avg $/k tokens, Active projects), and a new 'Invoices' filter bar (period / status). Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/EXAMPLE-ROUND3. Quick feedback please — UX + finance + eng constraints?

miguel: The small-multiples idea is smart for cross-project comparisons. Two thoughts: (1) default to 'Top by spend' not alphabetical, (2) consider a hover-to-compare mode where you can pin two charts side-by-side.

zhao: From infra: pinning two charts is ok but we should avoid fetching full token series for every project. Proposal: server returns a "lite" series for list (7-day avg) and a "full" series when user expands or pins. API sketch: `GET /v1/usage?view=projects&mode=lite` then `GET /v1/usage/{project}/timeseries?detail=full` on demand.

sam: Finance request: show both "Estimated" (near-real-time) and "Billed" columns on the invoice list. Add a tooltip: "Estimated may change until invoice finalizes". Also include a column for "Committed discounts applied" so customers can see reserved capacity impact.

katie: Accessibility fixes: the KPI strip numbers are currently low-contrast on small screens; bump font weight and use high-contrast tokens. Also keyboard focus order jumps from chart to footer; needs logical tab order. Please add `aria-describedby` for chart summaries and ensure charts have accessible table fallbacks.

leah: UX microcopy: Invoices list header currently says "Period" — change to "Billing period (start 12 end)" to avoid ambiguity. For the org/project toggle, label it "Scope" and add short helper text: "Viewing costs at the org level or per project".

anya: Good microcopy suggestion. For the charts, I tried both stacked area and small-multiples bars. Small-multiples got better quick-compare scores in the usability test. I'll keep stacked as a secondary view.

miguel: One more — token breakdown by model: instead of listing every model, collapse into "Top 3 models" + "Other" with a link to expand. Saves vertical space and helps quick scanning.

zhao: Agreed. On export: CSV should include a `breakdown_type` column (model/route/charge_type) so consumers can slice. We'll also add pagination keys to the CSV job response to avoid huge sync exports.

sam: Please ensure CSVs include a line for "invoice_adjustments" and that negative credits are explicit (column `adjustment_reason`). Also request: make invoice PDF generation include a short summary paragraph for non-technical billing contacts.

design-bot: Accessibility checklist: color contrast (WARN), keyboard nav (WARN), aria labels for charts (MISSING), CSV export present (OK), invoice summary copy (MISSING).

anya: Plan: I'll update Figma with (a) Top-by-spend sort, (b) helper copy for scope toggle, (c) KPI contrast tweaks, (d) collapsed token breakdown (Top 3 + Other). Will also add an interim visual for the pin-to-compare UX.

miguel: Sounds good. Can we get a lightweight prototype for the pin-to-compare before EOW? 15-20 mins to test with a couple customers next week.

zhao: I can build a small backend stub for the lite/full series endpoints by Thursday.

sam: Finance will review CSV and invoice wording on Friday. I'll post sample exports here.

anya: Thanks all — I'll update this thread with the next artboard and a short changelog. Ping me for pairing on the prototype. :rocket:
